reference_sql:
WITH numbered AS (  -- one row per subscription_events row as it arrived
  SELECT subscription_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
)
SELECT subscription_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_arrived, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE copy_no = 1) AS events
FROM numbered
GROUP BY subscription_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE copy_no = 1)
alternatives:
WITH events AS (  -- one row per event
  SELECT subscription_id, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
  FROM subscription_events
  GROUP BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local
)
SELECT subscription_id, SUM(n_rows) AS rows_arrived, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM events
GROUP BY subscription_id
HAVING SUM(n_rows) > COUNT(*)

SELECT t.subscription_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_arrived, SUM(CASE WHEN t.copy_no = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events
FROM (
  -- one row per subscription_events row as it arrived
  SELECT subscription_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id, event_type, event_date, mrr_delta_local ORDER BY event_id) AS copy_no
  FROM subscription_events
) AS t
GROUP BY t.subscription_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > SUM(CASE WHEN t.copy_no = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
